note: Synthetic sample reports written and labelled by the project author. Small and not independent: results are indicative only.

reports.text: There is smoke coming from the second floor of Block B and people are inside.
Flames visible in the canteen kitchen, staff are running out.
Small fire in the dustbin behind the library, minor, already mostly out.
Something is burning near the electrical panel in the chemistry lab, strong smell of burning plastic.
Sparks and a loud bang from the transformer near the hostel, now smoke is rising.
Fire alarm is ringing in the admin block, I can smell smoke in the corridor.
Kitchen gas cylinder is on fire, evacuate immediately!
Bonfire for the cultural night near the ground got out of control and is spreading to the tent.
Burnt smell coming from the AC in room 204, no flames.
A student has fainted in the seminar hall and is not responding.
Someone has chest pain and difficulty breathing near the gym entrance.
My friend slipped on the wet floor and has a cut on his hand, bleeding a little.
Girl in the library had an asthma attack, she has her inhaler but needs help.
Student running a high fever and vomiting in hostel room 12.
Snake bite near the football ground, a gardener was bitten on the leg.
Teacher feeling dizzy and weak in the staff room, needs a doctor.
He broke his arm while playing basketball, can't move it.
Need an ambulance urgently at gate 2, someone collapsed.
Student feeling anxious and crying after exam results, needs counselling.
Two bikes collided at the main gate, one rider is lying on the road.
A car hit the compound wall near the parking, nobody is hurt.
Bus driver lost control and the bus rammed into a tree, students are injured.
Scooter skidded on the wet road near the canteen, rider has a scraped knee.
A truck delivering supplies hit a pedestrian at the back gate.
Road accident just outside the college, an auto overturned.
Fender bender in the staff parking lot, minor scratches on both cars.
Student fell from the stairs near the lab and cannot stand up.
Cyclist was knocked down by a speeding bike near hostel road.
Someone stole my laptop from the library desk while I was away.
Two groups of students are fighting near the canteen with sticks.
An unknown man is roaming around the girls hostel and looking into rooms.
I am being followed by a guy every evening after class, feeling unsafe.
Senior students are ragging first years in the hostel corridor.
A man with a knife is threatening people near the main gate.
My bike parked near gate 3 was stolen last night.
Lost child crying near the parking area, parents not found.
Someone is trying to break the lock of the principal's office door.
There is no electricity in the entire engineering block since morning.
Water pipe burst near the library entrance, water flooding the walkway.
A huge crack has appeared in the wall of the old hostel building and the ceiling is falling.
Big pothole on the road near the main gate damaging vehicles.
Live wire hanging from the electric pole after the storm, children play nearby.
Manhole open on the walkway near the cafeteria, someone could fall.
Sewage overflowing from the drain near the hostel mess, terrible smell.
Gas leak smell from the lab pipeline.
Campus wifi is down in all buildings.
The tube light in classroom 305 is not working.
Ceiling fan in lab 2 is making a loud noise and wobbling.
Washroom tap on the first floor is leaking continuously.
The projector in the seminar hall is broken, please repair before tomorrow's session.
Dustbins near the canteen are overflowing and it smells bad.
Lift in B block is stuck between floors with two people inside.
Door lock of room 112 is jammed and I cannot open it.
Benches in the garden are broken and paint is peeling off.
The classroom is very dirty and needs cleaning before the exam.
Lost my ID card somewhere on campus, please help.
Stray dogs are barking and gathering near the hostel gate.
Loud music is being played in the next block after 11 pm.
There is a bee hive on the tree near the parking lot, could be dangerous.
A group of monkeys entered the canteen and are snatching food.
Please tell me whom to contact for a bonafide certificate.
Wallet found near the stationery shop, handing it over to the office.
